en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Umar al-Hafith al-Baghdadi (rh) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Musa narrated to us. He said: Khalaf b. Salim narrated to us. He said: Ghandar narrated to us. He said: `Awf narrated to us from Maymun Abi `Abdillah from Zayd b. Arqam. He said:

For a group from the companions of the Messenger of Allah (s), there were doors from the street to the Mosque. So, one day, he said: Close these doors except the door of `Ali. So, the people spoke about that. He said: So, the Messenger of Allah (s) stood, praised Allah and commended Him, then said: As for what comes after: surely, I was ordered to have these doors closed except for the door of `Ali, and some of you spoke about that. Surely, by Allah, I did not close or open anything, but rather I was ordered with something, so I obeyed it.
